query: build my training image and run it on 8 H100s in one node, should take about a day
expected_behavior: Builds/pushes the image with docker buildx --platform linux/amd64 before submitting
Uses a multi-GPU preset (8gpu-128vcpu-1600gb) driven by --container-command torchrun with --args "--standalone --nproc_per_node=8 ..." (space-separated, not comma-separated)
Does NOT attempt multi-node — states Serverless AI is one VM per job and points to Slurm/K8s for multi-node
Runs --dry-run, states the 8-GPU hourly/daily cost, and sets an explicit --timeout (~24h) before the gated create
Prints the resolved create command and STOPS for confirmation, then watches to a terminal state by polling (not --follow)
